newcomerCriteria: Five categories of non-citizen pupils may be admitted to a school, fixed by the parents' status
A student pass from the Department of Immigration comes before the pupil is admitted
The District Education Officer approves the year or form a non-citizen pupil is admitted to
The Registrar General of Educational Institutions and Teachers signs off the admission
A pupil whose transfer is approved is placed in a class according to his age

evidence.bullet: Five categories of non-citizen pupils may be admitted to a school, fixed by the parents' status
evidence.quote: The following categories of pupils whose parents are not citizens of Brunei Darussalam may be admitted to a school

evidence.bullet: A student pass from the Department of Immigration comes before the pupil is admitted
evidence.quote: obtain a student pass issued by the Department of Immigration

evidence.bullet: The District Education Officer approves the year or form a non-citizen pupil is admitted to
evidence.quote: Decision of District Education Officer: Admission of pupil to year/form is approved

evidence.bullet: The Registrar General of Educational Institutions and Teachers signs off the admission
evidence.quote: Decision of Registrar General: Admission of pupil to year/form is approved

evidence.bullet: A pupil whose transfer is approved is placed in a class according to his age
evidence.quote: The head teacher or principal shall place a pupil whose transfer has been approved in a class according to his age

sources.label: Education (School Admission and School Register) Regulations, S 10/04 (Education Act, Chapter 210, Rg 9), Revised Edition 2011: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam
